content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Online gumroad

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack that operates independently of payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. It combines free and paid tools to create a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This architecture is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. By owning the infrastructure, creators eliminate platform dependencies and gain permanent control over their sales channels.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. This combination ensures low-cost, high-reliability operations. The system is modular, meaning each component can be swapped or upgraded without disrupting the entire stack. Deployment takes 48 hours, and the creator owns everything afterward.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products. It’s specifically designed for regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines benefit most. The architecture addresses actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation—issues pressure-tested in Zimbabwe.
Stripe operates in only 46 countries—this stack works in all 195.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Pages provides fast, free hosting with global CDN distribution. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic with serverless efficiency. Supabase offers a scalable database for order storage. NOWPayments integrates 300+ cryptocurrencies for automatic payment verification. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations ensure email deliverability. Each component is selected for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. The stack is end-to-end tested before handoff to ensure seamless operation from payment to product delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by selecting the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a fully deployed solution in 48 hours. This includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration, with 5 products loaded and email configurations completed. Alternatively, purchase the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation and source code to deploy manually. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to choose your stack. Both options provide lifetime access and 30-day support. This is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed for permanent sovereignty.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, use sovereign commerce infrastructure to sell digital products. This architecture replaces Stripe and PayPal with automatic crypto payment processing via NOWPayments. Combine this with free hosting (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), serverless backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), and order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets). This stack operates independently of restricted platforms, giving you full control over your sales channel.
PayPal can hold your funds for 180 days—crypto payments can’t.

It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration, with 5 products loaded and email configurations completed. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to deploy your stack today. This architecture ensures you’re no longer dependent on platforms that exclude your region.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m in Nigeria or Ghana?

Yes, this stack is specifically designed for regions like Nigeria and Ghana where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. It uses crypto payments and free hosting tools to ensure you can sell digital products without platform restrictions.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates on-chain, meaning payments are verified directly on the blockchain. If their service is unavailable, payments still process—you just won’t receive instant webhooks. The system is designed for reliability.
Do I need technical skills to deploy this?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is fully deployed for you in 48 hours. If you choose the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), basic technical knowledge is helpful but not required. The documentation includes step-by-step instructions.
Can I use PayPal with this stack?
No, this stack replaces PayPal with automatic crypto payment processing via NOWPayments. This eliminates the risk of account suspension and fund holds, which can last up to 180 days with PayPal.
What if I want to add more products later?
The stack is modular and scalable. You can add more products by updating your backend logic and file delivery system. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 5 products loaded, but you can expand as needed.
